svg.title: North Carolina topographic sheet and registration-pin profile
svg.desc: A true unwrapped west-to-east section through W3, W1, W2, E2, E1, and E3. Every horizontal band is the actual intersection of one solid QGIS sheet with the bent section line.
svg.text: Registration profile · W3 → W1 → W2 → E2 → E1 → E3
Actual sheet intersections unwrapped by cumulative section distance
horizontal scale is cumulative section distance
